about.title: Mobile Developer Focused on Practical & Maintainable Products
about.desc: Graduated with a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang (KMITL). Currently working as a Mobile Developer focused on clean code, reliable store releases, and continuous learning.
about.p1_desc: Developing native Android apps using Clean Architecture, MVVM & MVI patterns, Jetpack Compose, and Coroutines/Flow.
about.p2_desc: Managing releases and updates on Google Play Console & Apple App Store Connect, including policy compliance, signing, and rollouts.
about.p3_desc: Updating legacy codebases to meet newer OS target SDK requirements, and integrating payment flows, sensors, and business APIs.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.desc: A selection of mobile applications, wearable health systems, and web/IoT projects.

p1.title: Health Record & Diabetes Risk Analysis App
p1.desc: Patient health monitoring app with diabetes risk calculation and heart rate measurement.
p1.f1: Heart rate measurement using smartphone camera PPG technology.
p1.f2: Health parameter tracking and diabetes risk prediction.
p1.f3: Historical health logs with trend charts.
p1.f4: Personalized health recommendations based on age, lifestyle, and BMI.

p2.title: Wear OS Abnormal Vital Detection & Alert System
p2.desc: Emergency assistance wearable system designed to monitor elderly or high-risk patients and send alerts to guardians.
p2.f1: Real-time heart rate and step counter monitoring.
p2.f2: Automated fall detection with an emergency SOS cancellation prompt.
p2.f3: Instant alert dispatching integrated with LINE via webhooks.
p2.f4: Web-based admin dashboard to manage smartwatch users and LINE Notify tokens.

p3.title: Automated Vehicle Access Control & Smart Parking Platform
p3.desc: Parking management platform combining license plate recognition with a web portal for payments.
p3.f1: Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) via Raspberry Pi 4 camera.
p3.f2: Admin dashboard for parking barrier access control and occupancy logs.
p3.f3: User web portal for parking fee calculation and QR invoices.
p3.f4: Integrated online payment gateway with responsive UI.
